summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 9, 2026, furnishing a news release detailing high-grade silver and gold drill results from its San Dimas mine in Durango, Mexico. Approximately 89,000 metres of the planned 117,000-metre 2026 exploration program has been completed year-to-date, with intercepts reported across the Sinaloa-Elia vein complex, Coronado-Carmen Escobosa system, and new targets at Convención and El Cristo. The filing is a routine operational exploration update, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed.
